title: Carry It Over
summary: Kendra Nimble wants 2 jars of lamp oil carried from the far end of Ravenscar to Dane Plover at the raven tower yard before anyone asks.
offer_text: "The jars of lamp oil are by my door and Dane Plover is waiting at the raven tower yard. It is a long walk and I have a bad knee. Take them over before anyone asks."

objectives.text: Take 2 jars of lamp oil from outside Kendra's door
Walk to the raven tower yard
Hand the jars of lamp oil to Dane Plover
